machine.name: localai/personal_health_baseline
machine.description: Personal health state classifier. Reads the worst-band-wins roll-up that localAIStack writes at [7574:7578] as a one-hot [thriving, balanced, watch, attention] and asserts the matching state at [7578:7582]. The roll-up is computed over whichever HealthKit families are in scope (data/health/health_bands.json, graded from the bridge's lanes at [4320:4344]); that set changes with the owner's authorization workflow, so the machine reads one fixed-width summary rather than one element per measure. All sequences are isInitial under PASSTHROUGH; the input is one-hot, so at most one fires per step, and an all-zero input (no graded band) fires health-none, which retracts the output to all zero.

metadata.author: localAIStack health bridge
metadata.eventSpace: 4D roll-up one-hot at [7574:7578]: [thriving, balanced, watch, attention], written by localAIStack (sensor localai_health_rollup)

localai_health_rollup.description: Worst-band-wins roll-up over the live band slots, one-hot; all zero when no band is graded

localai_health_slot_<band>.description: One element per band in scope (ok 1.0, watch 0.5, concern 0.0), allocated dynamically; a band out of scope has no slot and no source

stateLogic.grading: Each band in data/health/health_bands.json grades its HealthKit family ok / watch / concern (worst axis wins); without current data or below minConfidence it is not graded
stateLogic.balanced: Exactly one live band graded watch, none concern.
stateLogic.watch: Two or more live bands graded watch, none concern.
stateLogic.attention: At least one live band graded concern.
stateLogic.none: No band graded — the roll-up is all zero; health-none retracts the output to all zero
stateLogic.mutualExclusivity: The roll-up is one-hot, so no two sequences fire in the same step

localAIPromptHints.thriving: Every health measure in scope is in its nominal range.
localAIPromptHints.balanced: One health measure in scope is slightly outside its nominal range. A gentle nudge is enough.
localAIPromptHints.watch: Several health measures in scope are slightly outside their nominal ranges. Suggest an easier day and attention to rest.
localAIPromptHints.attention: At least one health measure in scope is well outside its nominal range. Recommend a health check-in.

governance.notes: localAIStack integration machine, registered into the RE at runtime by the reality bridge rather than loaded from the corpus.
